name: Zapier
description: Zapier lets agents run actions in the apps that the signed-in user connected in Zapier, such as finding a spreadsheet row or drafting an email. Each user signs in to their own Zapier account through the browser and picks the actions the agent can use.

prompts.text: Which Zapier actions can you use for me right now?
Find the row for order 1042 in my orders spreadsheet.
Draft a Gmail reply to the latest message from the design team, but do not send it.

apps.name: Zapier
apps.description: Actions in connected apps, over Zapier's MCP server with browser sign-in.
